# Pinterest (Russian)

> > Russian localization of Pinterest, the visual discovery platform for finding creative ideas, DIY tutorials, design inspiration, and lifestyle content across fashion, crafts, home décor, and art.

This is the Russian-language version of Pinterest (ru.pinterest.com), serving users with localized content including Cyrillic search terms, multilingual idea collections (Russian, Uzbek), and region-specific trending topics. The platform enables visual content discovery through pins, boards, and curated idea feeds.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest platform navigation
- Visual content discovery
- DIY crafts and templates
- Design inspiration
- Tutorial guides
- FAQ design patterns
- Login and authentication
- Ideas curation
- Trending content
- Printable templates
- AutoCAD tutorials
- Makeup tutorials
- Instagram integration
- Seasonal trends
- Lifestyle categories

## Core Platform Pages

- [Pinterest – Пинтерест (Homepage)](https://ru.pinterest.com/ru): Russian homepage for Pinterest with login/signup for discovering ideas
- [Explore the Best of Pinterest](https://ru.pinterest.com/ideas): Main ideas discovery feed with category browsing and curated content
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://ru.pinterest.com/today): Daily trending content featuring fashion, lifestyle, and seasonal trends
- [Pinterest Web Index](https://ru.pinterest.com/web/index/index): Alternative landing page with login/signup for recipes and home ideas
- [Pinterest Login](https://ru.pinterest.com/pin/1000010292323163517): Generic Pinterest login page with autocomplete navigation
